svg.title: Inventory Analytics Data Engineering Architecture
svg.desc: System architecture showing data flow from sources through Airflow orchestration, PostgreSQL storage, to Metabase dashboards, all containerized with Docker.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What data does the ERP system provide for inventory analytics?')
sendPrompt('What inventory data comes from POS systems?')
sendPrompt('How is supplier data ingested into the inventory pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What warehouse data feeds the analytics pipeline?')
sendPrompt('What does the Airflow webserver do?')
sendPrompt('How does the Airflow scheduler trigger DAG runs?')
sendPrompt('What DAGs should I build for inventory analytics in Airflow?')
sendPrompt('How do Airflow workers execute tasks in Docker?')
sendPrompt('How does the Extract task pull inventory data?')
sendPrompt('What transformations should I apply to inventory data?')
sendPrompt('How does the validate step work in inventory ETL?')
sendPrompt('How do I load transformed inventory data into PostgreSQL from Airflow?')
sendPrompt('What does the raw schema store in the inventory data warehouse?')
sendPrompt('What belongs in the staging schema for inventory analytics?')
sendPrompt('What tables belong in the analytics schema for inventory KPIs?')
sendPrompt('What does Airflow store in its metadata database in PostgreSQL?')
sendPrompt('How do I set up inventory KPI dashboards in Metabase?')
sendPrompt('What are good demand forecasting charts to build in Metabase?')
